nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: Studio fashion portrait of a woman sitting elegantly on the back of a natural-colored camel, posed like a high-end editorial image, with both sharing the same calm forward-facing posture; the woman wears bold textured blue fashion pieces, including a fluffy sculptural coat, ribbed blue turtleneck knitwear and matching tailored pants with smooth light-blue boots, while the camel remains in its realistic natural fur color and texture without clothing; the background is a solid saturated orange seamless studio backdrop with soft frontal lighting that enhances the textiles and camel’s fur, creating minimal shadows; shot with a professional full-frame camera such as Canon EOS R5 or Sony A7R IV using an 85mm f/1.4 prime lens for shallow depth of field and ultra-sharp texture details, hyper-realistic fashion editorial aesthetic with no painterly effects.
